build_host_unrelated_process: A server process left behind by an earlier, unrelated validation run stayed alive on the build host throughout, near one logical CPU. It was not created by this study and was not stopped.
scope: Includes this study's own builds, seeding, snapshots and harness containers; load averages are whole-host figures, not background-only.
unit: load1 is the one-minute load average; cpu_pct is top(1) percent of one logical CPU.
